clean_story:
Now I will teach you Worlds. Worlds is like many caves, but not in rock—each cave is a place where different beasts, trees, and skies live, all separate like fires on far hills. You can step from one to another, as if walking through a hidden path between caves. Each has its own sun, wind, and water, but none touch the others. You know your cave; Worlds is many caves like yours, together but apart. You see one, then another, then more, all held in the big dark like stars in the night sky.

Now go see: cave, path, sky.
